notes.title: Compete against other drivers with pace cars in v1.9.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150160/a60a8fe521cb9b7e6f592851459bc7a3a378b088.gif[/img]

In the v1.9.1 update we've added pace cars to the game. The pace car keeps the speed of the competitor ahead of  you on the leaderboard. That way it makes it a lot easier to instantly notice if you are driving faster or slower than the competitor you are trying to beat. In this update we've also increased the granularity of the race times as we now measure 0.00 seconds instead of just plain seconds. The update is now out on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox. Well hope that you'll enjoy it! 

[b]Change log for v1.9.1[/b]
* New feature: Pace cars which lets you race against the person ahead of you on the Hall of fame.

* Improved: Reduced size of Time, best time and rank on the finished race screen. 
* Improved: Added keyboard support to UI navigation and changing cars in the garage.
* Improved: Race times are now measured in 0.00s instead of just seconds. 
* Improved: Added settings to main menu instead of just in game. 
* Improved: 2 new music tracks added.
* Improved: Better AI handling. AI now drives in random lanes ensuring that they spread out more.
* Improved: Added more AI cars on most levels.
* Improved: On Nintendo Switch the leaderboard will show the top 100 players until you've completed your first race on each course. 

* Fixed bug: Hall of fame next button didn't detect clicks on texts, only on button.
* Fixed bug: Select car & buy car button didn't detect clicks on texts, only on button.
